articles.summary: Dewpoint Therapeutics today announced the opening of an Investigational New Drug (IND) application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration for DPTX3186, a first-in-class, only-in-class oral condensate modulator (c-mod) designed to selectively disrupt oncogenic Wnt/β-catenin signaling in tumors. Dewpoint plans to begin dosing its first patient before the end of 2025 in a combined Phase 1/2 trial conducted in partnership with leading cancer centers and key opinion leaders in gastric and other Wnt-driven cancers. Read the full press release to learn more.
